newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise on higher world levels.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise on higher world levels.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold exchange rose in line with European trends earlier on Wednesday and volume firmed on better free market demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $384.75 an ounce and 1,178,950 lira per gram, after $383.10 and 1,177,000 lira on Tuesday.
Traded volume was up 13.6 percent from yesterday to 875 kilos, with lira term deals making up 83.4 percent of it.
Volume was 380 kilos in the first session and 495 kilos in the afternoon.
